name: GO-SHIP seawater nutrient (N, P, Si) sample preservation by rapid freezing in a deep freezer at -20 C or colder
plain_name: Freeze seawater samples so their nutrients can be measured back on land
description: When nutrient samples from hydrographic cruises cannot be analysed within two to three days, the 3/4-filled, capped bottles are frozen as soon and as rapidly as possible in a deep freezer at -20 C or colder with good air circulation, kept in gridded racks, and thawed in air before continuous-flow analysis.
keywords: Freeze seawater samples so their nutrients can be measured back on land

sources.citation: Hydes et al. (2010) Determination of dissolved nutrients (N, P, Si) in seawater with high precision and inter-comparability using gas-segmented continuous flow analysers, GO-SHIP Repeat Hydrography Manual (IOCCP Report 14)

requirements.rationale: The storage space must reach -20 C (253.15 K) or colder.
Lowest achievable storage temperature must be -20 C or colder.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
